The complete course · English

System Design for Vibe Coders

Production engineering for AI-assisted builders. Every lesson is anchored in a real incident — from a real product's war-story bank or a famous industry outage — then turned into a principle, literal prompts to give your agent, and an evidence checklist so you can verify the work without reading code.
